ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity (white) to 55% low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixel distribution across the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity core extending from the notch. Left lobe features dense radial striations of low-intensity pixels against a high-intensity background. Right lobe presents a large contiguous high-intensity field with localized low-intensity mottling near the median line and trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with an estimated interior pixel angle of 130 degrees; the vertex point is submerged and partially obscured by surface water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular high-frequency serrations along the entire trailing edge. A significant macroscopic indentation is visible approximately one-third of the distance from the notch to the left tip. Right lobe edge exhibits moderate jaggedness with significant irregular protrusion at the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve with high-degree convexity on the proximal trailing edge transitioning to concavity towards the distal tips; right lobe displays a more acute upward sweep trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Prominent, high-density clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast pixel formations localized at the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes, consistent with localized biological colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous low-intensity linear pixel streaks (rake marks) oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge, most prominently detected on the high-intensity regions of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe indicating previous tissue loss; heavy calcified clusters on the distal extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Vertical high-contrast pixel trails originating from the lobe tips representing fluid displacement (water shedding).
